- [**Maggia**\\
\\
Place\\
\\
Just a few kilometres from the well-known Ticino resorts of Locarno and Ascona are the unspoilt romantic valleys known as the Valli di Locarno. The most well-known are the Centovalli, the Onsernone, Maggia and Verzasca valleys.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/valli-di-locarno/)
- [**Maggia Valley (Vallemaggia)**\\
\\
Place\\
\\
Experience the Maggia Valley in the south of Switzerland: Mountains, forests, Ticino villages and the river landscape of the Maggia – perfect for hiking, biking and Baden.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/maggia-valley-vallemaggia/)
- [**Maggiatal: Ride a 3-wheeled Vanderhall roadster starting from Locarno**\\
\\
OfferMinusioNovember 15, 2026\\
\\
Experience pure driving pleasure in the elegant three-wheeled roadster and explore the beautiful Maggia Valley on your own with adrenaline and panoramic views. The Maggia Valley is famous for its picturesque stone villages and the crystal-clear Maggia River.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/planning/offers/maggiatal-ride-a-3-wheeled-vanderhall-roadster-starting-from-locarno/)
- [**Garni Maggia**\\
\\
AccommodationCoglio](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/garni-maggia/)
- [**Percorso Valle Maggia, Stage 1/2**\\
\\
RouteBellinzona\\
\\
Through Piano di Magadino, the Ticino’s vegetable garden, then amidst European camping guests on the lovely lakeside promenade to Locarno, a happy mix of the German holiday dream, Ticino business people and Swiss German Italianità.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/percorso-valle-maggia-31_01/)
- [**Percorso Valle Maggia, Stage 2/2**\\
\\
RouteLocarno\\
\\
At Ponte Brolla the force of the River Maggia has cleft the rock, gouging out and polishing the gneiss. Life was hard in the Maggia Valley, the Ticino’s longest valley. Solace was provided by the church, as testified by edifices of religion and foreign governors.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/percorso-valle-maggia-31_02/)
- [**Percorso Valle Maggia**\\
\\
RouteBellinzona\\
\\
Through fertile, richly-yielding Piano di Magadino, lively Locarno on Lago Maggiore and the gardens of Pedemonte, to the romantic Valle Maggia. The powerful river has split, dug out and polished the light-grey gneiss.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/percorso-valle-maggia/)
- [**TCS Camping Gordevio Valle Maggia**\\
\\
AccommodationGordevio\\
\\
Welcome to Gordevio! Plunge into the invigorating waters of the crystal-clear Maggia River, take a walk and listen to the sounds of the magical forest, or start a crackling little fire on a rocky plateau by the shore: days and nights in Gordevio are made for people who want to get close to nature. The campsite has everything you need for a cosy, relaxing holiday.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/tcs-camping-gordevio-valle-maggia/)
- [**Mercato del Gusto**\\
\\
EventAsconaJune 12, 2027\\
\\
The Cantina alla Maggia is getting ready to host an extraordinary event with the top chefs of The Living Circle group, who will welcome their colleagues for a day of culinary pleasure.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/events/mercato-del-gusto/)
- [**Giro della Valle del Salto**\\
\\
RouteMaggia Valley (Vallemaggia)\\
\\
The itinerary «Valle del Salto» in Maggia leads on nice paths and represents no important differences in height. It winds into the valley passing by pastures, where you can admire paved and cobbled paths, beautiful stone stairs, sturdy retaining walls and many stone constructions.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/giro-della-valle-del-salto/)
- [**Sentiero Cristallina**\\
\\
RouteBignasco\\
\\
The Sentiero Cristallina links Bignasco in Valle Maggia with Airolo in Val Bedretto. Between them lie steep mountain slopes, a waterfall on a village outskirts, crystalline rock, Alpine lakes/reservoirs, idyllic alps and remote hamlets.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/sentiero-cristallina/)
- [**Breathtaking: Lake Narèt**\\
\\
RouteBignasco\\
\\
The route from Bignasco (pop: 300) to the source of the Maggia is exhausting; the views, however, are spectacular. The road leads through a dense forest of evergreens and past Lake Sambuco until it reaches Lake Narèt at alt. 2310 m.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/route/breathtaking-lake-naret/)
- [**Grotto America**\\
\\
RestaurantTegna-Ponte Brolla\\
\\
How did this 400-year-old grotto on the banks of the Maggia come by its cosmopolitan name? The answer lies way back: this is where the people of Ticino would eat one last meal before emigrating to America via Genoa.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/food-wine/restaurant/grotto-america-1/)
- [**Climbing in Ticino all year round**\\
\\
Experience\\
\\
Climbing in autumn? Or in winter? No problem in Ticino! In the Maggia Valley near Ponte Brolla, there are boulders that are becoming increasingly popular with sport climbers.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/climbing-in-ticino-all-year-round/)
- [**Ristorante Il Quadrifoglio**\\
\\
RestaurantMaggia\\
\\
Our eno-gastronomic offerings are at your disposal in the renovated restaurant in Maggia. In an elegant and refined environment you can enjoy our carefully prepared dishes made with always fresh products.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/food-wine/restaurant/ristorante-il-quadrifoglio/)
- [**Capanna d'Alzasca SAC**\\
\\
AccommodationRobiei\\
\\
The typical Ticinese stone building defined by rural simplicity is situated in the Maggia Valley at 1,734 meters.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/capanna-dalzasca-sac/)
- [**Capanna Alpe Spluga**\\
\\
AccommodationGiumaglio\\
\\
A Ticinese village of picture-perfect Alpine huts, located at 1,838 meters between the Maggia Valley and Verzasca.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/capanna-alpe-spluga/)
- [**Boutique Hotel Fusio**\\
\\
AccommodationFusio\\
\\
Boutique Hotel Fusio is set in the peaceful mountain village of Fusio at the far end of the Maggia Valley. The historic property has 11 individually designed rooms, combining Ticinese character with contemporary comfort and views of the surrounding mountains. Ristorante Da Noi celebrates the flavours of the region with fresh, local ingredients and a selection of Ticino wines. A sunny garden and terrace invite guests to relax, while hiking and mountain bike trails start close by. This comfortable, intimate boutique hotel also provides an ideal setting for retreats and team events in the fresh mountain air, with space for new ideas and renewed energy for everyday work.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/accommodations/the-unique-hotel-fusio/)
- [**Ristorante Da Enzo**\\
\\
RestaurantTegna-Ponte Brolla\\
\\
The right address for foodies and artists in the art of living is at the entrance to the wildly romantic Maggia Valley, in Ponte Brolla.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/food-wine/restaurant/ristorante-da-enzo-1/)
- [**Mario Botta Church in Mogno**\\
\\
ExperienceMogno\\
\\
Visit the famous Mario Botta Church in the Ticino village of Mogno: A masterpiece of white and black Ticino natural stone in the Maggia Valley.](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/mogno-mario-bottas-mountain-church/)
